page.layout: One page of running text in one column; no margin notes; the heading "DE SACRAMENTIS" is set centred in spaced capitals and continues on the next line; a catchword at the foot right.

main_text.head: Vitam aeternam.
main_text.p: Vitam aeternam esse extra Dei regnum & paradisum dicunt Pelagiani, Celestiani.
Vitam aeternam post resurrectionem constituunt in corporis voluptate & in hac terra, quae duratura sit mille tantum annos, Cerinthiani, Nepotiani, Chiliastae, Aeternales.
Vitam aeternam & Ierusalem caelestem esse in hac terra dicunt Pepuziani.
Paradisum verum esse coetus Ecclesiae, qui sunt in his terris, Adamitae.
Paradisum terrenum fuisse certum locum negant, Origenistae, Hierachitae.
Paruulos ad regnum Dei pertinere negant Hierachitae.
main_text.head: De inferno.
main_text.p: Poenas peccatorum esse in hac tantum vita dicunt Basilidiani.
Poenas aeternas esse temporaneas, & diabolos esse saluandos, Origenistae, Liberatores.
Limbos & purgatorium pro inferno substituunt Papistae.
main_text.head: DE ORATIONE.
main_text.p: Orationi vim & causam salutis nostrae tribuunt, Messaliani, Euchetae, Monachi.
main_text.head: DE SACRAMENTIS.

page.notes: The running head and the bottom catchword are as printed. The printed text reads "Sacramen-" at the foot as catchword and again at the start of the last line, so the last line is given as the catchword only. The word "daemonas" in the first line is printed as "dæmonas" with a ligature; transcribed as printed. Some words in the italic sect names are set in italic type with a long s, transcribed as printed. The left-hand edge shows show-through from the other side, not transcribed.
